paragraphs: In Eruvin 59b he asked Rabbah, who said to him: “Thus said Rav.” Rav Nachman said to them: “Do not listen to him; thus said…,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The two whole Davidson Eruvin 59b paragraphs have Rav Ami bar Ada of Harpanya ask Rabbah, who answers in Rav’s name, then Rav Nachman tells them not to listen. Local full titles, Rabbah rather than Rava, and the question/report directions are supported. The fragment remains incomplete with etc.; no additional legal discussion is imported.
